title: Quotient action on normal-subgroup invariants
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $G$ a group, $N\triangleleft G$ a normal subgroup, and $V$ an $R$-module. A representation here means a group action $\alpha:G\to\operatorname{GL}_R(V)$ by $R$-linear automorphisms. Define $V^N=\{v\in V:\alpha(n)v=v\text{ for every }n\in N\}$. There is a representation of $G/N$ on the $R$-submodule $V^N$ (an additive subgroup closed under scalar multiplication, as in [def-weil-submodule-span]) whose action is $(gN)\cdot v=\alpha(g)v$. In particular each $\alpha(g)$ preserves $V^N$, and elements of $G$ in the same coset modulo $N$ induce the same linear automorphism of $V^N$.
